name: skillopt-observe
description: SkillOpt Observe: audit a project's past Claude Code sessions and apply the resulting improvement suggestions, through two thin skills over the skillopt_observe CLI.

plugins.name: skillopt-observe
plugins.description: Analyst skill (audit sessions, report missed skills, detours, pipeline blockers, dead weight, environment health) and Fixer skill (apply one accepted suggestion as a branch + PR). Both wrap `python -m skillopt_observe`; nothing in them depends on Paperclip.
